snippet.title: The Lord of Novels (  Magic Cube's New game trailer / mobile )
snippet.description:
GooglePlay : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.magiccubegames.LON
AppStore : https://apps.apple.com/kr/app/id6754354331 

Do you remember 'The Lord of the Roads'?
After 15 years, 'The Lord of the Roads 2' is coming out under the name The 'Lords of Novels'. We've kept the unique systems like party shooting and dash mechanics, while adding numerous heroes, ultimate skills, parrying, roguelike progression, and more—
returning as a powerful sequel!It's time to fight again.
